title: Silent Instructions · Classic
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Silent Instructions · Classic with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Put a pencil and sheet of paper on a table and choose a partner. The lead uses gestures only to ask the partner to place the pencil in one of three agreed positions on the paper. The partner places the pencil in the intended position. Each player takes two turns. Give the lead one point for each successful turn. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Silent Instructions, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The partner places the pencil in the intended position.
recall.why: The partner places the pencil in the intended position.
